Name: Hyper-Resilient Fences
Author: OrangeGamingSystem
Description:
This mod makes one simple change. All vanilla fences will last one thousand times longer. It's primarily intended as an alternative option to No Fence Decay Redux for when that mod fails.

There are a few things of note however:
[list]
[*]This mod does not make fences indestructible, they will simply last a very long time.[/*]
[*]This mod will not apply to already placed fences, however repairing a fence while the mod is installed will bring it to the modded lifetime, even if the fence was placed beforehand.[/*]
[*]The effects of removing the mod have not been tested, based on the effects of applying the mod, fences will likely keep their elongated lifetime.[/*]
[/list]
Installation: Unzip the mod and place it in your Mods folder.

Requires: SMAPI and Content Patcher
